name: The Prodigal Lich Returns
summary: You carry an arcane communion gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity, after winning Gunther Arcanus's trust and restoring his grimoire.

sections.title: A Rare Reconciliation
sections.body: Gunther Arcanus spent years alone on an island in Brightwater Lake. By sheer force of will, he broke free from the Lich King's control, unaware that Sylvanas Windrunner had liberated Lordaeron. Bitter and wary of outsiders, he distrusted the Undercity's emissaries. An adventurer returned his spellbook and showed him their hostility toward the Scourge. Satisfied the visitor was no enemy, Gunther entrusted them with a Nether Gem to contact his former colleague.

sections.title: Communion in the Magic Quarter
sections.body: You return to the Undercity's Magic Quarter and deliver the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard. Bethor channels its power and conjures Gunther's ethereal visage in the sanctuary. Through their magical communion, Gunther formally agrees to ally with the Forsaken cause. Gaining a necromancer of his independent mastery bolsters the Dark Lady's young kingdom and its magical defenses against the Scourge and the living.

faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus is a powerful necromancer who broke free of the Lich King's mental domination by himself. He lived in reclusive exile on an island in Brightwater Lake, believing all other undead were mindless thralls until adventurers proved otherwise.
Bethor Iceshard is a senior mage and scholar who lives in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. An old colleague of Gunther Arcanus, he coordinated the effort to find and recruit him into the Forsaken.

faq.q: What does the Nether Gem do?
faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus gave Bethor Iceshard the Nether Gem, an enchanted artifact. When Bethor channels arcane power into it, the gem manifests a spectral image of Gunther so the spellcasters can speak across great distances.

faq.q: Why does Gunther agree to join the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Gunther spent years fearing he was Lordaeron's only free-willed undead. Convinced that Sylvanas's Forsaken are free of the Scourge and fight the Lich King, he willingly pledges allegiance and renews ties with his former peers.

faq.q: Why does the quest call Gunther a 'Lich'?
faq.answer: Gunther looks like any Forsaken, rather than a floating, frost-wreathed Scourge lich, yet the Forsaken call him one. A Kirin Tor student and skilled necromancer in life, he was raised by the plague during the Third War and later broke the Lich King's hold by himself.

faq.q: What happens when you turn in the Nether Gem?
faq.answer: When you deliver the Nether Gem, Bethor activates it and conjures Gunther's Visage in the Magic Quarter. The projection moves toward Bethor to begin their long-awaited reunion, then fades.

angles.text: Gunther's freedom without the Banshee Queen's help shows the willpower Lordaeron's fallen can muster.
Bethor's communion with Gunther joins traditional Dalaran spellcraft with the dark necromancy practiced in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.
Recruiting an independent master necromancer like Gunther strengthens the Horde's magical standing in the Eastern Kingdoms.
